تعجرفتا (form IIq)
# تَعَجْرَفَتَا (taʕajrafatā) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُعُجْرِفَتَا (tuʕujrifatā) /tu.ʕud͡ʒ.ri.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
